sql_templates.name: fetch_quality_breakouts
sql_templates.query: WITH enhanced_candidates AS (SELECT symbol, high, volume, market_cap_cr FROM scores.stage_snapshots WHERE enhanced_fund_score > 70), breakout_stocks AS (SELECT e.trade_date, e.symbol, e.high, e.volume FROM market.equity_eod e WHERE e.high >= e.week52_high) SELECT b.symbol, e.high, b.volume, e.market_cap_cr FROM breakout_stocks b JOIN enhanced_candidates e ON b.symbol = e.symbol

synthesis_guidance: Summarize only validated evidence, surface missing evidence, and keep research-only framing.

sql_templates.description: Retrieve current holdings with latest prices and scores.
sql_templates.template: SELECT p.symbol, p.qty, p.avg_cost, s.price, s.stage_score, s.trend_signal FROM portfolio.holdings p JOIN scores.stage_snapshots s ON p.symbol = s.symbol WHERE s.snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots)
